detail: 300 observations from 60 people; 30 people per group; every person has 5 visits; no duplicate person-visit rows.
No missing values in visit, person, group, or score.
nlme fit completed; convergence code is implicit success. Random-effects structure: correlated person intercept and slope. AIC 1350.5.
ML likelihood-ratio comparison of categorical versus linear visit: p = 0.2887 (lower values indicate departures from a linear time-by-group pattern).
Normalized residual Q-Q correlation = 0.996; Shapiro-Wilk p = 0.1379. The Q-Q plot is provided; the p-value is descriptive, not a model-selection rule.
Regression of absolute normalized residual on fitted value: p = 0.7755.

The primary model's pooled conditional-residual lag-1 correlation was -0.291. An AR(1) sensitivity model estimated phi = 0.012 and a slope difference of 1.361 (95% CI 1.107 to 1.614), versus 1.361 primary.
Leave-one-person-out interaction estimates ranged 1.328 to 1.396 points/visit; 0 of 60 refits failed.
Groups are observational; estimates describe association and should not be interpreted as causal programme effects without identification assumptions and confounder adjustment.
